scientific_integrity.claim_boundary: The source results on algebraic closure, type determination, and continuum many 4-types are prior inputs. The new claim is the exact low-arity census 2, 8, 48, the injective 3-type closure-size distribution, and the resulting complete all-arity spectrum.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No analogous exact formula is claimed for general T_{m,n}; the authors explicitly leave the corresponding minimal-arity/local-finiteness question open. Originality is based on targeted literature, semantic-database, exact-phrase, and prior-result checks.

title: Exact finite-arity type spectrum of the existentially closed projective plane
